requirement: A chat request longer than 4000 characters is recorded as truncated, not full

oracle.invariant: Both build checks print a count >= 1. LONG.length >= 4100 (above the 4000-character cap shared by the host and the turn door). A site_turn row TURN_LONG exists within 60 s of Enter (it is written when the turn opens, before the model runs). TURN_LONG request_state = 'truncated' (before #772: 'full' with a 3995-character title ending in '…', QA-A11 r1 on scv2wp; after: 'truncated', 3999 characters, QA-A11 r2). TURN_LONG char_length(title) <= 4000. TURN_LONG title ends with '…' (U+2026) and ends with neither '……' nor '… …'. TURN_LONG title starts with HEAD. TURN_SHORT request_state = 'full' and its title = SHORT. If the activity API returned an item with id TURN_LONG: its request.state = 'truncated' and request.text ends with exactly one '…'; an item with id TURN_SHORT has request.state = 'full'.
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer harness, needs stand, site:any, model, seat:owner

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
